Messages.Author: Scott Halvorson
Messages.Body:
Shadow of the Wolf:

The card gives an additional strike with +1 hand damage for the round of
combat at basic, with an optional press at advanced. Is the +1 hand
damage only for the additional strike, or can that apply to the first
strike as well?

Revelation of the Sire:

Card text: "Choose a Caitiff..." Can a Pander be chosen in the same
way? After all, they are kinda sorta the same clan, just a name change
to honor Mr. Pander who fought for Caitiff rights.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <35E9DF...@cptc.wisc.edu>, Scott Halvorson
<halv...@cptc.wisc.edu> writes

>Shadow of the Wolf:
>
>The card gives an additional strike with +1 hand damage for the round of
>combat at basic, with an optional press at advanced. Is the +1 hand
>damage only for the additional strike, or can that apply to the first
>strike as well?
>

Only usable before range is chosen. This vampire
gets an additional strike with +1 hand damage during
this round of combat.

The text says an additional strike with +1 hand damage. Seems like it's
only on that.

>Revelation of the Sire:
>
>Card text: "Choose a Caitiff..." Can a Pander be chosen in the same
>way? After all, they are kinda sorta the same clan, just a name change
>to honor Mr. Pander who fought for Caitiff rights.

No. Pander *are* a clan, both in V:TES and in V:tM. Caitiff are not a
clan. Caitiff are wholly separate from Pander as far as the card game
is concerned.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Scott Halvorson wrote:
> Shadow of the Wolf:
>
> The card gives an additional strike with +1 hand damage for the round of
> combat at basic, with an optional press at advanced. Is the +1 hand
> damage only for the additional strike, or can that apply to the first
> strike as well?

Only for the additional strike.

> Revelation of the Sire:
>
> Card text: "Choose a Caitiff..." Can a Pander be chosen in the same
> way? After all, they are kinda sorta the same clan, just a name change
> to honor Mr. Pander who fought for Caitiff rights.

No. Pander are not Caitiff. Their clan is Pander and their sect is
Sabbat. Pander is a "new" clan introduced in the Sabbat(tm) exapnsion
[Sabbat rulesheet: "New clans"]. Members of Sabbat versions of
Camarilla clans "are not members of the Camarilla versions of their
clans" [Sabbat: "Brotherhood Among the Sabbat"]
